newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends lower on European selling.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends lower on European selling.

text.p: Hong Kong spot gold ended a shade down on Tuesday from New York's previous close on selling from Australia and Europe, bullion dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$347.30/80 an ounce against New York's US$347.40/90 close on Monday.
Some dealers reported Australian selling prior to the Sydney market close.
When London opened, bearish sentiment led to selling, which pushed gold below $347 before subsequent shortcovering lifted prices back up to closing levels of $347.30/80, dealers said.
Traders reported some physical buying around $346.50 but said demand was only fair and not a big factor in the market.
Gold would seek slightly lower levels as punters were disappointed by it shunning higher levels, dealers said.
Local gold ended HK$7 lower at HK$3,212 a tael.
